backlog.spec: Replace 'Adam' with 'AdamW' and set weight decay to 0.1. Use keyword argument 'AdamW'. This adds a 'W' layer to the 'AdamW' layer.

backlog.spec: Replace the fixed warmup and downramp with a poly1 ramp.
backlog.title: Poly1 LR

backlog.spec: Replace Adam with SGD-Weight Decay optimizer. Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 (from 0.2) and set EMBEDDING_LR to 0.1 to speed up convergence on larger batches.
backlog.title: SGDW Adapter

backlog.spec: Replace current constant LR schedule with Cosine Inverse. Keep WARMUP_RATIO at 0.0 but add COINE_RATIO = 1.0 and INITIAL_LR = 0.0005 (approx).
backlog.title: Cosine Schedule

backlog.spec: Replace current schedule with Linear Scheduling. Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0 and LINEAR_START = 1.0 to reduce dead zone.
backlog.title: Linear Scheduling

backlog.spec: Replace Adam optimizer with AdamW. Keep existing betas but increase WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to handle larger matrices and help convergence on large batches.
backlog.title: AdamWeightDecay

backlog.spec: Replace current schedule with NoWarmup. Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0, WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.0 and LINEAR_START = 1.0 to maximize early learning rate.
backlog.title: NoWarmup Schedule

backlog.spec: Replace Adam with ZeroCrossing. Increase batch size in devices (find where overflow happens), or increase learning rate significantly to stabilize.
backlog.title: ZeroCrossing Optimizer

backlog.spec: Replace current fixed positional encoding with learned positional encoding. Reduce EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.1 to allow positional embedding learning while keeping other parameters stable.
backlog.title: Learned Positional Encoding

backlog.spec: Increase DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 64 to 128. If this causes OOM, reduce model depth or use mixed precision (already implicitly handled). This will help convergence.
backlog.title: Batch Size Increase

backlog.spec: Replace Adam with MiniBatch optimizer. Increase BASE_BATCH_COUNT by 10% to use more data per step, or increase matrix count.
backlog.title: MiniBatch Adapter

backlog.spec: Replace tokenization by chunking data into smaller pieces. This will increase throughput and potentially improve val_bpb by better utilizing the model.
backlog.title: Data Chunking

backlog.spec: Replace the constant-time warmup phase with an exponential decay schedule over the first WARMUP_RATIO of steps to stabilize early gradients, gradually reducing warmup LR toward the final learning rate.
backlog.title: Exponential LR Warmup

backlog.spec: Split the global BATCH_SIZE among transformer layers such that some layers process fewer tokens than others, avoiding the need to round trillion-tokens to a fixed multiple of ASPECT_RATIO. This can significantly reduce per-layer weight operations and attention strides.
backlog.title: Layer-based Batching (Nonuniform Batching)

backlog.spec: Use relative position embeddings instead of absolute learnable positional embeddings. This reduces the size of the position embedding table, freeing VRAM and potentially improving generalization on short sequences.
backlog.title: Relative Positional Encoding

backlog.spec: Incrementally increase the effective number of gradient accumulation steps between optimizer steps (without increasing batch size) to widen the curriculum, utilizing more of the 40GB VRAM budgeteper step by training longer before accumulation.
backlog.title: Gradient Accumulation Step Control

backlog.spec: Apply dropout to attention output scores immediately after the Softmax interface before attending to the QK^T product, to increase regularization in the attention block and reduce overfitting.
backlog.title: Dropout on Attention Scores

backlog.spec: Replace the native sliding window attention mechanism with a Layer Cross-Attention wrapper that uses a standard window mask and optional apply-bias, allowing flexibility in attention mask width without refactoring the entire attention module.
backlog.title: WindowMasked Layer Cross-Attention

backlog.spec: Apply a separate, smaller weight decay to the cached memory KV states than to the Q query projections, as the cached KV states are less critical for generalization and thus can be regularized more lightly without affecting convergence.
backlog.title: Adaptive Weight Decay for KV Cache

backlog.spec: Use a batch size that scales up over time following an annealing schedule based on remaining tokens per run, allowing the model to start with smaller batch sizes and gradually increase to maximize training stability.
backlog.title: Annealed LayerBatches

backlog.spec: Clamp the gradient norm to prevent exploding gradients and reduce magnitude variations, improving training stability especially on smaller batches or early training stages.
backlog.title: Gradient Norm Robustness

backlog.spec: Perform a lightweight pretraining pass for 1 hour to calibrate the optimal depth of the transformer layers (e.g., reduce DEPTH from 8 to 4) and then resume training at the optimal depth where val_bpb is minimized.
backlog.title: Layer-Wise OpCost Calibration
